infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Spottr uses your location while the app is open to show nearby food trucks and restaurants. Your precise location is not saved to your profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Spottr uses photo access only when you choose a business logo or attach a photo to a review.

plugins.photosPermission: Spottr uses photo access only when you choose a business logo or attach a photo to a review.
plugins.cameraPermission: Spottr uses the camera only when you choose to take a business or review photo.
